arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Goldblatt argued the debtor's exemption claim was fully proper.
Mr. Goldblatt stated the trustee did not object because the claim was unobjectionable.
Mr. Brunstad argued the debtor indicated intent to exempt the property in full.
Mr. Brunstad stated the trustee denied the debtor an opportunity to allocate the exemption.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: A debtor claimed an exemption for specific kitchen equipment. The trustee sought to sell the property and pay the debtor the cash value. The lower court ruled in favor of the debtor keeping the equipment.
